provenance_note: ComBat aggregates solvent properties 'from public databases & literature'. The `De` column is therefore NOT a primary measurement. It may not be counted as an independent experimental source, and if its underlying reference turns out to be NBS 514 or ThermoML it must be merged into that primary-study cluster rather than treated as new evidence.
property_caveat: `De` has no frequency field. Treating it as a static relative permittivity is an ASSUMPTION, not something the file establishes; records without a recoverable primary reference stay EXPLORATORY.

field_dictionary.Abbreviation: short solvent code used in the ComBat figures
field_dictionary.DN: donor number, FROM PUBLIC DATABASES & LITERATURE
field_dictionary.De: dielectric constant, FROM PUBLIC DATABASES & LITERATURE (secondary)
field_dictionary.DeT: temperature (degC) at which De was measured, FROM PUBLIC DATABASES & LITERATURE

not_recovered: per-solvent MD artefacts (radial_distribution_functions/, polysulfide_clustering/, solvation_structures/, diffusion/, coordination_numbers/) are simulation output for other quantities and are not evidence about experimental dielectric constants
